data.name: Onkarraj
data.gender_notes: Onkarraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The syllable ‘Onk’ is a symbol for the creator Brahma, ‘Aar’ represents Rudra (Shiva), and ‘Ja’ stands for the god Vishnu. So, Onkarraj is a name of God, representing the combined energies of all three deities. The name Onkarraj carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Onkarraj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes a sense of the divine and connects the bearer to the universe and its creators.
data.etymology: Onkarraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Onkarraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Onkarraj holds immense cultural significance in the Hindu Faith as it embodies the supreme Godhead, representing the collective consciousness of the universe and all its beings. Chanting this name is believed to bring peace, harmony, and an unwavering connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Onkarraj implies the unity and interconnectivity of all beings and the Absolute Truth. It signifies the infinite and all-pervading nature of God, as acknowledged by various Hindu philosophies like Advaita and Vishishtadvaita. This name instills a sense of deep reverence, devotion, and surrender to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Onkarraj is a name derived from the Hindu word 'Onkar', which represents the ultimate reality and the supreme cosmic power. The 'Raj' suffix implies the one who rules or reigns over this reality, symbolizing the divine ruler or the king of the universe.

historical_references.reference: Onkarraj is a name mentioned in the Hindu scripture 'Satapatha Brahmana'. It is the name of a sage who is said to have performed the Ashwamedha Yajna, a horse sacrifice.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Onkarraj continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
